statistics.PSNR: poolfloat64SSE/(3validpixels), then -10log10; independently per scene/focus, each aperture also reported
statistics.patch_pool: whole unmasked fixed64px grid weighted by regional pixel support
statistics.RGB: standard displayRGBfloat[0,1];raw linearEXR retained;3D integrates true linearRGB
statistics.full_image: all pixels including sky and peeled-reference residuals

quality.direction: PSNRgain>0 AND LPIPSchange<-3noise;absLPIPSchange<=3noise is tie,not direction improvement or significant deterioration
quality.guardrails: per-focus pooled full-image and in-focus PSNR versusO3 each drop<=0.2dB; individual cases also reported

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

band.definition: 3x3 relative inverse-depth jump, union of max-local-CoC1.5x footprints; exclusively target current visible depth
band.primary_evaluation: band excluding previously flagged peeled-reference residual pixels;band itself is never GT-filtered
band.report: independent disocclusionGT recall/precision/FP/FN, unknownGT support and CoC distribution; no tuning toGT recall

high_light_influence.definition: max_RGB abs(S(Cycles_linear)-R_LDR)>0.02 in displayRGB; no dilation
high_light_influence.report: imagefraction,counts,spatial heatmap/connectedcomponent distribution and overlapwith frozen scoringregions;also influenced/uninfluenced scores
high_light_influence.not_pure_light_ground_truth: difference also includes finiteK andMC noise;not used to selectmethod content

references.primary: unchanged Cycles full-scene GT at nominal1.4/5m
references.auxiliary: unchanged R1 LDR consistent mean64; no new reference generation
references.noise: existing R2 Cycles lens noise and R1 max independent-pair LDR noise

target_focus.rule: median used method depth inside original R3 GT in-focus mask at nominal focus/current aperture; GT mask simulates user-selected target only
target_focus.shared: O3_SHARP,VG_SHARP,SHARP front/full andretrieval variants share the same front-depth scalar percase/scale; cached O3_DA3/VG_DA3 retain original R3 depth/focus
target_focus.score_masks: original nominal GT scoring masks unchanged

fill.rule: same U2 input-side depth-band mask and background-depth extension + fixed LaMa; recompute SHARP mask/fill from its own depth where needed, not GT segmentation/hidden depth
fill.sharing: per frame/scale one fill and background depth for VG_SHARP/front/full/retrieval E1/E2, same per-ray lookup; native fill never receives Oracle S
fill.compositing: merge visible/back/retrieved Gaussians, depth-sorted alpha on each lens ray, residualT*Cfill, linear mean64; retrieved hidden active only outputband, no opaque LaMa covering hidden

anchor.optimized: output Gaussian RGB colors only; optional bounded opacity. Network weights,means,scales,rotations fixed
anchor.initialization: exact original SHARP full2layers; calibrated geometries independently restart from mapped original attributes, not from the native fitted checkpoint
anchor.colors: linear RGB projected to[0,1] afterevery update, preservingoriginal SHARP bounded color policy; no HDR recovery
anchor.optimizer: Adam eps1e-8, colorlr0.01,opacity-deltalr0.01; cosine factor1to0.01 over1000 steps
anchor.loss: 0.8 target displayRGB L1 +0.2(1-SSIM11sigma1.5), all target pixels,zeroaperture K1,sharedAAeps0.0015,remainingT*samefixedtargetLaMa
anchor.supervision: only current target inputLDR RGB; no otherframeRGB,DOF,apertureviews,GTdepth or evaluationmasks read byoptimizer
anchor.selection: fixed final1000 only, no checkpoint selection byany scores
anchor.stop: nonfinite loss/attributes OR inputloss>5x initial for3 consecutive monitors OR finalinputPSNR<=initialinputPSNR; save exactstep andcontext before raising

stage: S1c dense flow calibration, hidden retrieval ladder, predicted-depth edge-masked color anchoring

flow.model: original official RAFT large, raft-things.pth preferred; torchvision public RAFT weights fallback only if original unavailable
flow.image_source: same clipped-linear LDR RGB as S1; displayRGB uint8, network0..255
flow.pairs: per E1/E2 target all13frames: >=0.01m baseline; choose largest baseline in each of4 target-camera XY angular quadrants, then fill by baseline descending to6; compute union directed pairs and reverse for FB; no GTdepth
flow.multiview: median axial depth across pair triangulations; at least2 additional views agree within max(0.005m,2%depth), then reprojection <=1px ineachsupportingview; no GT masks

calibration.features: OpenCV SIFT nfeatures4000,contrast0.02,edgeThreshold10,sigma1.6; grayscale uint8 from inputLDR only
calibration.matching: mutual nearest descriptor, Lowe ratio0.75 bothdirections, symmetric epipolar distance<=1px usingprovidedposes
calibration.pixel_convention: keypoint OpenCV arrayindex xy +0.5 for camera pixel centers; depth bilinear sampled at original index xy
calibration.tracks: union consistent featurematches,onekeypoint/frame; reject merging same-frame-conflict components; >=3 views
calibration.triangulation: multi-view DLT fromprovidedK/E, positive depth inall observations, maxreprojection<=1px, maxrayangle>=0.1degree; noGTdepth/segmentation/dynamiclabels
calibration.split: heldout spatial32x32 image blocks,20% chosen with seed2026111032+frame+variant before balancedstratum caps; no point inbothsplits
calibration.near_far_reporting: triangulated axial depth below/above2.5m,plus data median split; noGTdepth used for segmentation or fit
calibration.fit: per frame anddepthsource ytri=1/ztri=a*(1/zpred)+b, robustHuber delta0.005 m^-1, SLSQP fixed maxiter500
calibration.bounds: a in[0.05,20],b in[-2,2] m^-1; constrain a*minimum_input_inverse_depth+b>=1e-4; weak1e-6 identity regularizer; no spatialterms
calibration.mapping: zcal=1/max(a/z+b,1e-4); report flooredpixel/Gaussian counts, noGT-basedcorrection or validationselection
calibration.Gaussian_mapping: every SHARP Gaussian mean multiplied zcal/z alongits own ray; all3 scales multipliedsamepositivefactor,quat/opacity/color unchanged beforeanchor. Includes bothlayers
calibration.validation: heldout sparse inverse-depth errorsbefore/after,notusedtochoosebestfit; preserve finalfittedcoefficients; GTdepth read onlylaterforreports
calibration.risk: rigid-track verification cannotcertify allmoving-object matches; no newmotionsegmentation method
calibration.geometry_stop: any main13 frame/Evariant belowminimum cannot supportregisteredcalibration; report before expansion
calibration.method: same bounded robust affine inverse depth as S1b
calibration.sampling: sample fixed4px lattice from geometry-consistent densepoints; near<2.5m,middle2.5<=z<4m,far>=4m inverse-depth strata, cap2000points/stratum/frame with seed2026111031+frame+variant; no resampling after scores
calibration.support_rule_note: S1b did not freeze an independent near-count minimum; add explicit near/far25train10held floors here, all previously frozen numerical support thresholds retained
calibration.validation_stop: stop if heldout inverse-depth RMSE OR heldout sparse depth AbsRel increases beyond1e-10 absolute arithmetic tolerance; check eachframe,eachdepthsource,eachEvariant before GTdepth reports

comparisons.P3: A_color_cal_Ek+L3_cal_Ek vs A_color_cal_Ek; primaryband;guard sameA_color_cal_Ek; E1/E2 separate
comparisons.P4: each calibrated O3_SHARP,O3_DA3,A_color,A_color+L3 minus native paired counterpart;primaryband;guard native counterpart
comparisons.P5: A_color_edge vs A_color,primaryrecoverable,focuses separately;guard A_color; native primary,calvariants separate
comparisons.guardrail: pooled full and in_focus PSNR vs named control >=-0.2dB

edge_anchor.edge: 3x3 relative inverse-depth range>3% localmax from corresponding SHARP first-layer depth only
edge_anchor.L1: exclude dilated edge pixels;normalize by retained RGB scalar count
edge_anchor.SSIM: same11x11 sigma1.5,only windows fullyoutside exclusion;renormalize retainedwindows; no GT

ladder.visible_layers: same A_color visible cloud for each native/cal_E1/cal_E2 set; hidden switches alone
ladder.GT_reference: O6-GT-rec is recoverable-surface GT Oracle reference,not a mathematical bound on the combined biased visible representation
ladder.GT_retrieval: all13 visible GTdepth/GTposes with inputLDRRGB,including target current visibleGTdepth forbehind filter; no targethiddenGT,onlyallowedOracle
ladder.ordinary_retrieval: unchanged L3 nearestbehind relativemargin0.005,within1% nearest depth median RGB/depth; no motioncompensation,nonewfilter
ladder.band: eachvisiblegeometry same predicted-depth/CoCband and samefill used for all ladderlevels
ladder.composition: merge visible+activehidden,sortdepth alpha perray;remainingT*LaMa lookup;linear meanK64
ladder.wrong_hidden: GT usedonlyafterretrieval to count depths <target currentvisibleGTdepth-max(.001,.005*GTdepth); tagged rendering contribution; no point deletion byGT

optional6.reason: optional training-cost diagnosis deferred; complete primary questions and respect calibration stop first

after_stop: report and stop expansion; independent edge/ladders not automatically continued without user steering
constraints: no GTdepth/masks in optical flow,triangulation,calibration oredge mask
